chapter: Starting out and leading a band
title: Riding a truck band to advertise dances
summary: He describes six-piece bands on trucks advertising dances, and why a happy band matters.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals

blocks.x: That's the first time I ever seen anything like that.
Well I guess that's just made him feel good. That's right.

You'd be surprised when you do some people. You know what he told me? He told me, he said, well I just come in Joseph. He's from New York. He said, I've been around places. When I never seen a place Mr. Commander got us to play. When the same girl watched his name find him about nine times. So then Mr. Moran told him, he's gonna show him how he makes the carnival parades down there. Well all the guests, white girls and white boys, they're all in applause. They got the girlfriend man, watching her on. And we playing watching with him. Man, that was something good to see. So now I didn't see something like that. That was really good. They have nice parties. Now, other thing I had played on these little appetizers. Nice to play every Sunday for the Hawks at the center centers. Where they have a dance. Nice to play the appetizers too. When was that? How long ago was that? Oh that's a good while ago. That's about three months ago. Oh three months ago. Three months ago. That time we used to have bands and trucks. Do you understand what I mean?
About six pieces riding on the truck. You see they go around riding in cars.
You did that just three months ago? Yeah, yeah. Oh I didn't know.
Do that, going around different places like that. And appetizing. You understand for the dance. You were on the truck? Yeah. On your band?

We used six pieces like that. Six pieces. Six pieces. We ride around the truck. Go maybe uptown. We leave from uptown. We come down to Burgundy. And when we coming in. Going to the center center. Well we start the plane from Yale. Playing either the same group marching in. With the truck going slow. And they make like a parade. The boys get out the automobile. They get to put their car and they march. And they march to the center center. It's like a parade. Oh you're riding the hall.

They make a parade out of it. You'd be surprised how much cake that is. What a truck be going slow. At the same time. You understand what I mean? Yeah. And man it. Billy do me so good sometimes. When I. See them boys having fun like that. Sure. Sometimes I'm sorry when it's over.

You know what? I be enjoying myself. Sure. I be enjoying myself. Just like it's me down there. Go see we in the working. And all them boys in the band they like that too. Yeah. See that makes. That makes. That's what makes a band.

Makes people happy. And makes people happy and that makes you a band. It's the best thing in the world to be with a bunch of men. Everybody agreed in one thing. And then. I'm going to play. I'm going to play. I'm going to play.
